title: Fix typos in docs/spelling_wordlist.txt via codespell
body:
Auto-fixed typos in `docs/spelling_wordlist.txt` using `codespell`. The following corrections were made:

- aci -> acpi
- afterall -> after all
- aks -> ask
- ans -> and
- anser -> answer
- assigment -> assignment
- astroid -> asteroid
- connexion -> connection
- juli -> july
- OptIn -> option
- pretify -> prettify
- sade -> sad
- ser -> set
- statics -> statistics
- WIT -> WITH
